name: Lush Ruin Meadow
description: Denser meadow grass where the old city drains still hold water.
role: An alternate of the Ruin Meadow that breaks tile repetition.

artBrief.spriteScale: Seamless square tile. Floor entities tile it over a 4×4 cell footprint.
artBrief.silhouette: Flat tile, slightly denser than the base meadow.
artBrief.detail: More mint highlights and fewer gaps between clumps.
distinctiveFeatures: denser clumps than the base meadow
artBrief.paletteDirection: Same emerald set as the Ruin Meadow.
